stories.title: Distributed Attacks in Persistent-State AI Control
stories.author: Asa Cooper Stickland
bullet_points: The paper addresses a novel security vulnerability in autonomous AI coding agents due to persistent state across iterative code changes.
It introduces 'Iterative VibeCoding' to model the dynamics of safely deploying capable but potentially untrusted AI systems.
The core threat involves prompt-injected agents distributing malicious payloads across multiple pull requests for stealth.

stories.title: Program-as-Weights: A Programming Paradigm for Fuzzy Functions
stories.author: Yuntian Deng
bullet_points: Introduces 'Fuzzy-function programming' to handle complex, non-rule-based tasks (e.g., log alerting, JSON repair).
Proposes compiling natural-language specifications directly into compact, locally-executable neural artifacts ('Program-as-Weights').
Addresses current limitations of relying on LLM APIs, specifically concerning locality, reproducibility, and cost.

stories.title: ReContext: Recursive Evidence Replay as LLM Harness for Long-Context Reasoning
stories.author: Jingrui He
bullet_points: Addresses the critical limitation of LLMs failing to effectively utilize relevant evidence within long input contexts.
Introduces RECONTEXT (Recursive Evidence Replay), a novel, training-free inference method designed to improve long-context reasoning.
Focuses on bridging the gap between LLMs' ability to access long context windows and their actual ability to leverage that information.

stories.title: Program-as-Weights: A Programming Paradigm for Fuzzy Functions
stories.author: Yuntian Deng
bullet_points: Introduces 'Fuzzy-function programming' to handle complex, rule-based tasks poorly suited for traditional code.
Proposes 'Program-as-Weights,' a method to compile natural language specifications into compact, locally executable neural artifacts.
Addresses current limitations of relying on LLM APIs (locality, reproducibility, cost) for everyday programming tasks.

stories.title: OrbitQuant: Data-Agnostic Quantization for Image and Video Diffusion Transformers
stories.author: Saurabh Shukla
bullet_points: Introduces OrbitQuant, a new data-agnostic quantization method specifically designed for Diffusion Transformers (DiTs).
Addresses the high inference cost of DiTs, which is exacerbated by multi-step sampling and large parameter counts.
Solves a critical limitation of prior quantization methods where activation shifts across different timesteps and prompts required constant re-calibration.

stories.title: Online Safety Monitoring for LLMs
stories.author: Eric Nalisnick
bullet_points: LLMs still produce unsafe outputs post-alignment training, necessitating real-time monitoring.
The research proposes a simple, real-time monitor that uses an external model's verifier signal for alarm decisions.
The monitor's threshold is calibrated using risk control and shows competitive performance in red teaming and reasoning tasks.

stories.title: LACUNA: A Testbed for Evaluating Localization Precision for LLM Unlearning
stories.author: Verna Dankers
bullet_points: Addresses the critical issue of LLMs memorizing sensitive PII from training data.
Focuses on 'unlearning' techniques, specifically evaluating localization precision for post-hoc data removal.
Highlights a gap in current research: existing benchmarks only test output-level erasure, not true knowledge removal from model parameters.

stories.title: Online Safety Monitoring for LLMs
stories.author: Eric Nalisnick
bullet_points: LLMs still produce unsafe outputs post-alignment training, necessitating real-time monitoring.
The research proposes a simple, real-time monitor that uses an external model's verifier signal for alarm decisions.
The monitor's effectiveness is shown to be competitive in mathematical reasoning and red teaming tests.

stories.author: Shahriar Noroozizadeh
bullet_points: Investigates how social structures (role, audience) influence LLM agent behavior in multi-agent debates.
Compares public utterances to off-the-record (OTR) responses to detect latent objective emergence.
Proposes a dual-channel debate framework to study the impact of relational context on AI communication.

stories.title: Reasoning LLM Improves Speaker Recognition in Long-form TV Dramas

bullet_points: The research addresses the challenge of speaker recognition in complex, long-form TV dramas.

The study leverages Reasoning LLMs to improve the accuracy of speaker attribution in video content.

stories.title: DemoPSD: Disagreement-Modulated Policy Self-Distillation
stories.author: Linqi Song
bullet_points: Introduces DemoPSD, a new method building upon On-policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) for LLM training.
Addresses a critical limitation of existing OPSD: dense, privileged token-level supervision causes overfitting and poor cross-domain generalization.
The research aims to improve LLM reasoning capabilities by mitigating the negative effects of overly strong teacher supervision.

stories.title: G-RRM: Guiding Symbolic Solvers with Recurrent Reasoning Models
stories.author: Günter Klambauer
bullet_points: Introduces G-RRM, a neuro-symbolic approach that integrates Recurrent Reasoning Models (RRMs) with traditional symbolic solvers.
Utilizes Symbol-Equivariant RRMs (SE-RRMs) to generate full solution proposals and guide classical solvers like SAT-based methods.
Focuses on improving extrapolation capabilities of neural models to handle larger constraint satisfaction problems.

stories.title: LACUNA: A Testbed for Evaluating Localization Precision for LLM Unlearning
stories.author: Verna Dankers
bullet_points: The paper addresses the critical issue of Large Language Models (LLMs) memorizing sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII) from training data.
It critiques existing 'localize-first, unlearn-second' unlearning methods, noting that current benchmarks only test output-level erasure.
The research introduces 'LACUNA' as a new testbed to evaluate the precision of knowledge removal within the model itself, not just at the output.

stories.title: Online Safety Monitoring for LLMs
stories.author: Eric Nalisnick
bullet_points: LLMs continue to produce unsafe outputs even after alignment training, necessitating real-time monitoring.
The research proposes a simple, real-time monitor that uses an external model's verifier signal for alarm decisions.

stories.author: Shahriar Noroozizadeh
bullet_points: Investigates how social structures (role, audience) influence LLM agent behavior in multi-agent debates.
Compares public utterances against off-the-record (OTR) responses to detect emergent, unprompted objectives.
Introduces a dual-channel debate framework to study the impact of relational context on LLM communication.

stories.title: DemoPSD: Disagreement-Modulated Policy Self-Distillation
stories.author: Linqi Song
bullet_points: Introduces DemoPSD, a new method to address limitations in On-policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) for LLMs.
Identifies that traditional dense token-level supervision in OPSD can cause overfitting and hinder cross-domain generalization.
Aims to improve LLM reasoning capabilities by modulating disagreement during the self-distillation process.

stories.title: Controllable Sim Agents with Behavior Latents

The agents learn a per-agent Gaussian behavior latent from discounted returns, enabling controllable behavior.

stories.author: Xiang Lorraine Li

Proposes a 'Neuron-Aware Data Selection' method for annotation-free self-distillation.
Utilizes the LLM's own outputs and majority voting across rollouts to generate pseudo-labels for self-supervision.

stories.title: Understanding the Robustness of Distributed Self-Supervised Learning Frameworks Against Non-IID Data
stories.author: Dong Yuan
bullet_points: Addresses the critical challenge of data heterogeneity (non-IID data) in Distributed Self-Supervised Learning (D-SSL).
Provides a rigorous theoretical analysis to understand how various D-SSL frameworks perform under real-world, decentralized data conditions.
Contributes to the foundational understanding of D-SSL robustness, moving beyond purely empirical studies.

stories.title: LACUNA: A Testbed for Evaluating Localization Precision for LLM Unlearning
